name: workbench
description: A side pane for Git review, a file browser and the branch's GitHub pull request and Actions runs. Needs only git; no daemon or CLI to install.

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: Optional. A GitHub personal access token for private repositories, a higher rate limit and re-running failed Actions jobs. Leave empty for public repositories.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the Workbench pane when a session starts.
